evidence: well_viewer/persistence/registry.py:65 adds PersistenceRegistry.flush_all(); allwell.py:1625 calls it in closeEvent (after commit_focused_notes) and well_viewer/core/load_controller.py:387 calls it before begin_load. _flush (registry.py:82) now early-returns when the domain is no longer pending, so a stray timer landing after the swap cannot write the old plate's state into the new directory.

well_viewer/core/export_prefs_state.py:38 ExportPrefsState.reset_for_new_dataset() drops the axis *limits* per figure via plot_style.drop_axis_limits (which clears both the flat keys and axis_buckets), and load_controller.py:411 calls it on every dataset swap. Log flags and mark styling are deliberately retained, with the reason written in the docstring.

well_viewer/persistence/_doc.py:71-78 sets state.dataset.persistence_doc_degraded on an unreadable/non-object file, and write() (line 149) refuses to overwrite: it renames the file to persistence.unreadable-N.json via _set_aside_unreadable, and abandons the write entirely if that rename fails.

well_viewer/persistence/cell_overrides.py unchanged since PR #782: lines 64-65 and 110-111 still `except OSError: pass`; line 161 `if current_fp and stored_fp != current_fp` still fails open when the well's _out.zip is absent (current_fp == ""); line 186 still gates the compensating warning on `file_version < _SCHEMA_VERSION`, so a v2 file with empty seg_fp entries warns about nothing.

well_viewer/persistence/reset_scopes.py:269 still claims "line_order" in VIEW_DOMAINS, but reset_view (line 274) only calls view_state.reset, _save(ctx,"heatmap_layouts") and _save(ctx,"multivariate") — there is no _save(ctx,"line_order"), so the stale `line_order` section stays on disk and line_order.load_from_data_dir re-applies it (and _reorder_selections_by_line_order) on the next load.

ctx.runtime.view_state.absent_wells / absent_solo are assigned only in view_state.restore (lines 462, 485) and cleared only in view_state.reset (lines 1088-1089). load_controller.begin_load (lines 400-440) clears plot/export_prefs/image_view/channel caches but never these, and load_from_data_dir (line 1023) early-returns when the new plate has no view_state section — so dataset A's wells are still unioned into B's snapshot (view_state.py:105,117).

well_viewer/persistence/heatmap_layouts.py:37 still persists `"tp_index": int(tp_cb.currentIndex())` and line 175-182 restores it by clamping to the live item count — an index, not a timepoint value, so adding timepoints re-points it at a different tp.

well_viewer/persistence/sample_definitions.py:216-219 hydrates well_labels only for tokens in ctx.state.dataset.well_paths, and autosave_to_pipeline_info (line 62) rebuilds the block from ds.well_labels alone via build_sample_definitions_v2 — there is no absent-label stash equivalent to view_state's absent_wells, so labels for wells outside a subset load are erased on the next autosave.

well_viewer/persistence/smfish.py:124-160 still does an unlocked read-modify-write of pipeline_info.json (json.loads then atomic_write_json), as does domain/gating_state.py:200-238 (save_gating_to_pipeline_info). No file locking exists anywhere in the repo — grep for fcntl/flock/filelock/LOCK_EX returns nothing.

well_viewer/core/channel_state_controller.py:187-188 still `if all_vals.size == 0: return` inside _recalculate_threshold, skipping channel_state.apply_range (line 195) and the whole cell-gating hydration tail (lines 197-220). load_controller.py:415 clears only threshold_range_cache, so ChannelState.threshold_min/max keep the previous dataset's values.

well_viewer/features/smfish/tab_view.py:935 _after_csv calls _smfish_persist.save_threshold(ctx, channel, thr) with no data-dir check, and save_threshold resolves the path from the *current* ctx.state.dataset.data_dir. worker.py:367-370 still invokes after_csv_cb even on a shortfall, and the mid-write-loop abort (_abort_write, line 344) reaches that call — so a swap landing during the CSV write loop still stamps the old threshold into the new dataset's pipeline_info.json. The pre-write guards (lines 322-333) close only the earlier window.

well_viewer/features/home/groups/panel_view.py:81-91 builds `new` as `plate.selectedWellIds() ∩ well_paths` and calls sel_set_composition(ctx, sid, new); selection_controller.sel_set_composition (line 1072) sets s["wells"] = _clean_wells(wells) outright, so wells the current dataset does not hold are dropped from the group and then autosaved.

well_viewer/persistence/_doc.py:79-97: a schema_version mismatch now sets doc = {} (it really does apply defaults) and marks state.dataset.persistence_doc_foreign, and write() (line 144) refuses to write over the foreign file rather than merging into it.

well_viewer/features/saved_plots/tab_view.py:124-134 _confirm_clear still has `except Exception: swallowed()  # no dialog (e.g. headless) — fall through to clearing` followed by an unconditional C.clear_saved_plots(ctx). git log -L on the function shows it untouched since PR #782, so the comment is the original author's rationale, not a post-review decision.

batch_export/scatter_panel.py:369-385 _warn_if_live_gates_ignored documents that batch export deliberately does not inherit the tab's live Apply-gates toggle (a batch job silently changing population from another tab's checkbox would be worse) and logs a warning when the tab is filtering; it is called at lines 498 and 724, covering both cell-collection paths. ARCHITECTURE.md:2264 records the same decision and openly notes the log line is a stopgap — the shortfall is still not visible in the exported artifact itself.

well_viewer/features/export/service.py:678-685: the tab's Export CSV now passes `gates=(_scatter_gates_for_axes(ctx, col_x, col_y) if _scatter_points_gated(ctx) else None)` to _scatter_collect_data, matching scatter/controller.py:125.

well_viewer/features/image_browser/image_table/export.py:70-83 adds _load_cell_array, which resolves a ratio channel via _find_ratio_for_channel/_load_ratio_array before falling back to _load_array; both export call sites (lines 391 and 443, i.e. the aspect probe and the per-cell render used by Export to File / Copy PNG / Copy SVG / Save to Saved Plots) go through it.

well_viewer/features/export/service.py:600-621 _axis_column_names suffixes _x/_y only when the two names collide (including via the derived _error columns); export_scatter_agg_data uses it at line 767 for both the row dicts and the DictWriter fieldnames (line 807).

well_viewer/features/export/service.py:687 export_scatter_data calls the same `name_x, name_y = _axis_column_names(col_x, col_y)` and uses those names for both the row keys (lines 701-702) and the fieldnames (line 723).
well_viewer/features/multivariate/renderer.py:17 imports apply_export_style_to_current and render_multivariate ends with it at line 59, before canvas.draw_idle().

well_viewer/features/export/sidebar_view.py:1093 _redraw_active_plot now branches on `tab in ("Spatial", "Multivariate")` and dispatches through app._ctx.features.redraw(app._ctx, tab), so Reset-to-defaults repaints _mv_fig.

well_viewer/core/plot_card_actions.py:81 and :118 both take an optional card_attr resolved by name through _named_card, and all eight tab Export menus pass their own card to all three actions (e.g. barplot/tab_view.py:232-236, lineplot/tab_view.py:103-107, scatter/cells_tab_view.py:190-194). The bare fallback to first-visible remains only for the global toolbar action.

well_viewer/features/batch_export/scatter_panel.py:844-849 (_run_scatter_agg_multi_tp_job's _draw) still calls ax.errorbar with label/marker/linestyle/capsize/alpha and no `color=data["color"]`, while the single-timepoint sibling at line 697-702 passes it.

well_viewer/features/batch_export/base_panel.py:1754 snapshots _ch_selected once outside _run_group, while _run_group re-reads _val_col (line 1791) and _metric (line 1793) from the live combos on every job; bar_panel.py:276-278 does the same (_val_col/_metric re-read per job, _ch = _ch_selected). The runner pumps QApplication.processEvents() between jobs (base_panel.py:1641), so a combo change mid-run yields a mismatched channel/column pair.
well_viewer/features/saved_plots/controller.py:287 export_report_pdf now passes list(reversed(store.records)), matching the gallery's newest-first order built at tab_view.py:149.

well_viewer/features/image_browser/image_table/controller.py:834-837: for a pre-rendered RGB cell (arr.ndim >= 3 and not NUC+SEG) the live path still does make_overlay_thumb(cropped, sz, sz, lo, hi) with the row's _parse_lut window, skipping draw_cell_chrome and mark_uncorrected — while export.py:452-465 sends every non-overlay cell through cell_display_rgb plus chrome plus mark_uncorrected and thumbnails at a fixed 0..255.

well_viewer/features/multivariate/renderer.py:216-222 keeps `_point_colors(data, "group")` with a comment explaining that the Colour-by combo is scoped to MODE_DIMRED and hidden whenever the SPLOM is on screen (the SPLOM is reached only from MODE_CORRELATION, whose payload carries no color_by key), so reading res["color_by"] would honour nothing.

well_viewer/features/batch_export/base_panel.py:663-681 _app_val_col_scope still restores conditionally — `finally: if saved is not None: chan.active_val_col = saved` — so when the pre-existing active_val_col was None the app is left holding the batch's column. Its sibling _app_group_scope (line 738) restores unconditionally.
